fields.label: Full Name
fields.description: Matched with a loose LIKE search at check-in — spelling variants may not catch. Prefer ID number or phone for a reliable match.

fields.label: ID / Passport Number
fields.description: Exact match. Most reliable field — fill this in whenever it's known.

fields.label: Phone Number
fields.description: Exact match against the visitor's phone as entered at the gate.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Active entries are checked at the gate. Set to Inactive to lift a block without losing the record.

fields.label: Restrict To Company
fields.options:
Karen Roses
Kaitet Group
Kaitet Ltd.
fields.description: Leave blank to block this person at every company's gate. Set a company to restrict the block to that company only.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Shown only to gate/security staff when a match is blocked — never shown to the visitor or printed on any badge.
